adapter_scope: Offline deterministic replay of explicitly supplied filesystem/config/permission/version state only; no OpenCode execution or live loader reuse.
native_runtime_authority: Native OpenCode diagnostics/runtime state are authoritative for live session, remote, managed/account/org, plugin, MCP, provider, tool, model, and approval state.

rules.statement: Project AGENTS.md files are discovered upward from cwd to the explicit project root when project config is enabled and cwd is within the project.
rules.false_certainty_notes: No filename match outside the supplied project root is promoted to active semantics.
rules.supported_rationale: The adapter walks the supplied root-to-cwd directory chain and records existing AGENTS.md files.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: A nested AGENTS.md on the supplied cwd ancestry is applicable to that directory context.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Future tool-access or unrelated directory context is not inferred.
rules.supported_rationale: Directory applicability is bounded to the explicit cwd ancestry.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: A supplied global OpenCode config directory may contribute AGENTS.md instructions.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Live environment-derived config directory state is not inferred.
rules.supported_rationale: The explicit global config directory is inspected without deriving account state.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: When an explicit custom config directory contains AGENTS.md it takes precedence over the ordinary global AGENTS.md source.
rules.false_certainty_notes: The adapter does not read OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR from a live process environment.
rules.supported_rationale: The caller supplies both directories; the custom AGENTS.md is preferred when present.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: Instruction paths are de-duplicated before neutral records are emitted.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Content-equivalence across different paths is not guessed.
rules.supported_rationale: Canonical resolved paths are de-duplicated deterministically.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: An explicitly reported unreadable discovered project instruction source makes the bounded instruction result unresolved instead of silently dropping it.
rules.false_certainty_notes: The adapter does not manufacture or suppress filesystem permission failures.
rules.supported_rationale: An inert read-error snapshot can mark a discovered project instruction unavailable.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: The adapter does not manufacture or suppress filesystem permission failures.

rules.statement: When project instruction discovery is explicitly disabled by the caller snapshot, project AGENTS.md sources are ignored.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Omitted disable state is not inferred from filenames.
rules.supported_rationale: The explicit disable state is honored without reading a live environment flag.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: A cwd outside the supplied project root does not receive project instruction semantics and is reported unresolved for project applicability.
rules.false_certainty_notes: No ancestor search outside the supplied project root is treated as semantic proof.
rules.supported_rationale: Root containment is checked deterministically.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: No ancestor search outside the supplied project root is treated as semantic proof.

rules.statement: OpenCode documents Claude Code instruction fallbacks, but this Phase E adapter does not claim the complete fallback resolver from the bounded native AGENTS.md source alone.
rules.false_certainty_notes: CLAUDE.md is not promoted by filename-only inference.
rules.supported_rationale: The boundary is surfaced explicitly.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: CLAUDE.md is not promoted by filename-only inference.

rules.statement: A supplied inert remote-config snapshot is treated as a lower-precedence base than local snapshots.
rules.false_certainty_notes: No .well-known or remote URL is fetched.
rules.supported_rationale: Only already-materialized JSON is replayed.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: A supplied global config snapshot overrides conflicting remote-base values.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Live account or organization state remains outside this claim.
rules.supported_rationale: Bounded snapshot order is remote then global.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: A supplied custom config snapshot overrides conflicting global values in the bounded replay.
rules.false_certainty_notes: No custom path is discovered by executing OpenCode.
rules.supported_rationale: The custom snapshot is explicitly supplied and ordered after global.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: A supplied project config snapshot overrides lower local layers in the bounded replay.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Additional live .opencode directory state is not invented.
rules.supported_rationale: The project snapshot is explicitly supplied and ordered after custom.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: A supplied inert inline-config snapshot has the highest precedence in the bounded replay.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Environment-derived OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT is never read automatically.
rules.supported_rationale: The inline snapshot is an explicit caller input.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: Supported object fields are deep-merged across supplied snapshots instead of replacing the entire object.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Schema coercion, variable substitution, plugin resolution, and side effects are not reproduced.
rules.supported_rationale: Plain JSON object fields are recursively merged for the bounded snapshot subset.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: When multiple supplied config snapshots contain instructions arrays, the arrays concatenate in precedence order and duplicate entries are removed.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Instruction content loading remains a separate boundary.
rules.supported_rationale: The adapter reproduces the current mergeConfigConcatArrays rule for inert strings.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: If the caller does not declare the bounded config snapshot set complete, the merged snapshot remains unresolved rather than treating missing layers as empty live config.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Missing managed/account/remote/session state is never interpreted as absence.
rules.supported_rationale: Known supplied layers may be shown while final bounded state is unresolved.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Missing managed/account/remote/session state is never interpreted as absence.

rules.statement: Custom instruction glob declarations are visible in supplied config, but Phase E does not expand arbitrary globs into effective instruction content.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Glob expansion and effective content are not guessed.
rules.supported_rationale: Pattern declarations are preserved with provenance.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Glob expansion and effective content are not guessed.

rules.statement: Permission declaration order is semantically significant and must be preserved.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Rules are not alphabetically sorted or normalized in a way that changes precedence.
rules.supported_rationale: JSON object insertion order is retained while flattening the supplied permission snapshot.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: The last permission rule matching both permission and pattern wins.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Session approval overlays are not folded into static config rules.
rules.supported_rationale: The bounded matcher evaluates rules in declaration order and returns the last match.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: Permission patterns use deterministic wildcard matching for * and ? in the bounded snapshot matcher.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Shell parsing semantics beyond the supplied comparison string are not inferred.
rules.supported_rationale: The supported wildcard subset is explicit and tested.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: Once/always approval choices are live session state and cannot be derived from static permission config.
rules.false_certainty_notes: No current-session approval is invented.
rules.supported_rationale: The adapter reports session approval state as conditional/unresolved unless an explicitly supported immutable snapshot exists.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: No current-session approval is invented.

rules.statement: Live .well-known or other remote config retrieval is outside deterministic inspection.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Network fetches are never performed and supplied snapshots do not prove current remote state.
rules.supported_rationale: Already-materialized inert remote JSON may participate in bounded replay.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Network fetches are never performed and supplied snapshots do not prove current remote state.

rules.statement: Remote instruction URLs declared in config are not fetched by Codex Scope.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Remote instruction content is unsupported in the deterministic core.
rules.supported_rationale: The declaration can be reported.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Remote instruction content is unsupported in the deterministic core.

rules.statement: OpenCode plugin discovery and execution are not performed.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Plugin code, hooks, tools, and outputs are never executed.
rules.supported_rationale: Plugin declarations can be recognized as an excluded surface.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Plugin code, hooks, tools, and outputs are never executed.

rules.statement: MCP declarations do not authorize connecting to or executing MCP servers.
rules.false_certainty_notes: MCP-provided instructions, tools, and runtime state are unsupported.
rules.supported_rationale: Declaration presence may be recorded as excluded.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: MCP-provided instructions, tools, and runtime state are unsupported.

rules.statement: Managed, MDM, account, and organization-derived effective state remains runtime/installation state unless a separately supported inert snapshot is supplied.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Missing managed/account/org snapshots are not treated as empty.
rules.supported_rationale: The adapter exposes the missing runtime boundary.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Missing managed/account/org snapshots are not treated as empty.

rules.statement: A caller-supplied OpenCode version/revision is recorded as supplied provenance without executing the OpenCode binary.
rules.false_certainty_notes: A supplied marketing/package version is not automatically claimed compatible with the pinned source revision.
rules.supported_rationale: Version provenance is caller supplied and the evidence revision is checked separately.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Outside the stated supported boundary the adapter fails closed.

rules.statement: An externally detected version may be recorded only as caller-provided detected provenance; the deterministic core performs no detection.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Codex Scope does not invoke the OpenCode executable.
rules.supported_rationale: The source of detection is represented explicitly.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Codex Scope does not invoke the OpenCode executable.

rules.statement: When no version/revision provenance is supplied, version state remains unknown.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Config shape and filenames are never used to guess a version.
rules.supported_rationale: Unknown remains unknown.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Config shape and filenames are never used to guess a version.

rules.statement: A supplied evidence revision different from the pinned inspected revision is classified outside_evidence.
rules.false_certainty_notes: Behavior at uninspected revisions is not silently labeled compatible.
rules.supported_rationale: The mismatch is explicit and fail-closed.
rules.unsupported_or_unresolved_rationale: Behavior at uninspected revisions is not silently labeled compatible.
